items.title: Common Widgets: Labels, Buttons, Entry Fields, Menus, and List boxes

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Common Widgets: Labels, Buttons, Entry Fields, Menus, and List boxes as printed (PDF 52, printed 48); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the topic 4.1 lesson.

blocks.text: Widgets are the basic elements used to build a graphical user interface. A Label is used to display text or messages on the screen. A Button allows the user to perform an action when it is clicked. An Entry field is used to enter text, such as a name or password. A Menu provides a list of options at the top of the window. A Listbox shows a list of items and allows selection from the list.
